comment: Judged on the paper's metric (C-C, r0 = 1.000, T <= 0.15, tracker). Three in-domain runs (H, V, D) give RMSE/L 0.00706, 0.00696, 0.00703 against bar 0.024. As for P-0017, T = 0.15 is at the noise floor, so this does not test K or P; it supports only the short-window reproduction at r0 = 1.
